hero.title: José Camilo Joga Guerrero.
hero.description: I'm a Platform & DevOps Engineer with a cloud engineering foundation: I build and run Kubernetes platforms on AWS and Azure. My work centers on Infrastructure as Code, GitOps delivery, observability, and AI agents wired into CI/CD — turning sprawling, manually-managed environments into self-service platforms teams run themselves.

about.title: About
about.heading: Building systems that scale.
about.paragraph1: Hello! I'm José Camilo (please call me Camilo), a Computer Science Engineer drawn to DevOps and cloud since the start of my career. I build efficient, scalable, automated infrastructure.
about.paragraph2: I've taken environments from manually-managed servers and console-clicked clusters to managed Kubernetes platforms on AWS and Azure, with GitOps delivery, Infrastructure as Code, and observability built in. The part I enjoy most is the consolidation work — collapsing sprawl into something simple and self-service.

experience.title: Experience
experience.heading: Where I've worked.

globant.title: DevOps Engineer
responsibilities: Operate a multi-region Azure platform — 300+ services on AKS, released through Azure DevOps pipelines and PowerShell

Run the Databricks platform as code — multiple workspaces deployed through Bicep, a Unity Catalog metastore per region with its permissions and compute settings, and dedicated general-purpose clusters per environment in every workspace

Embedded Claude agents into the CI/CD platform — an autonomous security agent scans repositories, files GitHub issues under its own identity, then blocks any later PR touching that code until the issue it raised is resolved

Built Azure DevOps pipelines that deploy Databricks jobs and install their dependencies on the clusters from Git-sourced notebooks; a Declarative Automation Bundles PoC (formerly Databricks Asset Bundles) now extends them to deploy each job's latest parameters

Built the agent tooling — skills, hooks, and sub-agent personas that turn Snyk output into a readable PR comment, and MCP servers exposing internal tooling — running on AKS as GitHub Apps with short-lived scoped tokens and Workload Identity into Key Vault

Lead a self-service portal for audited, PII-masked access to Azure SQL and MongoDB behind a one-click approval queue, plus gated Kubernetes operations — live on many environments for developers, data analysts, QA and load-testing teams, with the global production rollout in progress
Led the consolidation of every alert and dashboard into one alerts-as-code repository and GitOps release pipeline covering all environments and regions

Lined up two PoCs: an environment-oriented re-architecture of the Bicep deployments so a greenfield environment is one deployment, and an SRE agent plugin on Anthropic's open standards (Agent Skills, MCP) for distribution to teams across the organization
Maintain and extend the Bicep infrastructure platform, and enabled Azure Synapse for a developer team with a gated promotion model, deployed entirely as code
Drive an in-flight migration of AKS clusters onto Cilium, and replace manual incident remediation with self-healing automation

Automated GitHub Copilot enablement across multiple orgs under one enterprise — seats, access, per-org budget — plus workflow-dispatch and variable orchestration that keeps pipeline structure consistent across teams

kodepull.title: Co-founder & CTO
responsibilities: Co-founded the company in 2025 to deliver enterprise-grade engineering to businesses without enterprise budgets
Own the technical side as CTO: architecture, infrastructure design, platform and vendor decisions, and the quality bar every project ships under
Lead hands-on engineering and delivery across web, custom software, cloud, and mobile
Recent deliveries: mobile app work and web design and deployment projects, on top of recurring maintenance, domain renewals, and hosting
Run KodePull's on-prem K3s cluster — workloads for clients who keep their data on local hardware, and the relay and backup site for the production clusters in the cloud and in datacenters
Scale specialist engineers, designers, and partners onto each engagement as the work needs them
Partner with the CEO on technical strategy, keeping delivery mapped to business outcomes

flBetances.title: DevOps Engineer
responsibilities: Embedded in a banking institution's core DevOps team, supporting 50+ engineering teams and a continuous automation backlog
Maintained and extended an in-house Azure DevOps deployment framework — YAML templates that detect project type, target environment, and required policy checks
Ran nightly deployment operations across all teams, tracing failed deploys through ArgoCD and AKS to the policy or template at fault
Built Power Automate flows for the approval, notification, and ticket-lifecycle processes around DevOps work
Built a Vue.js and .NET self-service portal: repositories, permissions and infrastructure through approved templates, not tickets
Led an internal Terraform module library letting teams self-provision cloud resources within bank policy; handed off near-complete at contract end

arctiq.title: DevOps Consultant
responsibilities: Designed and led the migration of 60+ applications from a hand-built Rancher setup to a managed AWS EKS platform — FluxCD, GitLab CI, and Terraform
Lead SOC 2 readiness for the client's regional expansion, tracked in Secureframe, while the EKS platform grows from a single AWS region to multi-region
Delivered a Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP) Ultimate deployment for a customer moving from OpenShift to Nutanix — architecture, deployment, and the documentation their team needed to take ownership
Consolidated branch-per-team sprawl into per-team namespaces, cutting 5–8× of redundant deployed surface
Built observability from zero — OpenTelemetry instrumentation with Grafana, Loki, and distributed traces across every application
Local team mentor: oversee the health of peers' projects and guide them on cloud, Kubernetes, and security; led Terraform workshops that moved dev teams to self-service infrastructure
Rolled out SSO with AWS Identity Center and Entra ID, retiring IAM users for assumed roles and pipeline OIDC
Embedded SOC 2 controls into delivery — automated CI/CD checks, IaC policy, and GitLab merge-request gating across lower and production environments
Standardized resource governance with Kubernetes LimitRanges across every environment, and documented the EKS architecture as code in D2
Run containerized agent workloads on Terraform-provisioned EKS and Fargate — IRSA for pod-level AWS access, GitOps delivery with CI audit on the managed repo
Led a week-long Azure enablement workshop for a client team — cloud fundamentals and governance through networking, compute, data and AI, and operations

projects.title: Projects
projects.heading: Things I've built.

kubestronautSim.title: Kubestronaut Exam Simulator
kubestronautSim.description: Open-source exam simulator for the Kubestronaut path — one command boots a real Kubernetes cluster, draws each attempt from a growing pool of original questions, and grades behavior, not YAML. Deliberately harder than the real exams.

cicd.title: EKS Platform Migration
cicd.description: Designed and led the migration of 60+ applications from a hand-built Rancher setup to a managed AWS EKS platform — FluxCD for GitOps delivery, Terraform for the cloud underneath.

iac.title: Self-Service Terraform on Azure
iac.description: An internal library of Terraform modules that let a bank's teams deploy Azure resources themselves, with the variables and behaviour its policies require built into every module.

monitoring.title: Observability from Zero
monitoring.description: Observability for a platform that started with none — OpenTelemetry feeding Grafana, Loki, and distributed traces, with dashboards and alerts on every application.

infrastructure.title: Alerts-as-Code Pipeline
infrastructure.description: Consolidated every alert and dashboard into a single repository and a GitOps release pipeline that deploys and reconciles them across all environments, regions, and severities.

portal.title: Self-Service Infrastructure Portal
portal.description: A Vue.js and .NET portal that lets developers self-provision repositories, manage permissions, and request infrastructure through approved templates and guardrails instead of tickets.

containerization.title: KodePull's On-Prem Kubernetes Cluster
containerization.description: The six-node K3s cluster I built as a homelab, now KodePull's: it runs workloads for clients who keep their data on local hardware and backs up the production clusters, with OpenBao secrets, Envoy Gateway, a Cloudflare Tunnel and in-cluster CI runners. It hosts this very site.

terminal.label: Terminal
terminal.heading: The cluster behind this page.
terminal.description: This site runs on KodePull's on-prem K3s cluster, which I built and operate: OpenBao secrets, in-cluster CI runners and Prometheus metrics, behind Envoy Gateway and a Cloudflare Tunnel. The terminal connects to it read-only and shows the site's namespace and the platform layer, so you can inspect pods and see how it is put together.
